display_text: Suppressed Power ** Adds [[Intimidate|Intimidate +15]][[Intimidate|Intimidate +15]]: Passive: +15 [[Competence bonus]] to the [[Intimidate|Intimidate]] skill.[[Category: Intimidate +15 items]] ** Adds [[Deception]][[Deception]]: This weapon is hard to focus upon and thus provides a +3 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks.
